serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: We got the shoes on, what now?
Melissa: There are holes in the ball, you put your fingers in them…
Melissa: Like that.
You: That looked very skillful.
Melissa: I will throw first, observe…
STRIKE!{{punch}}
You: Uh, isn’t that the perfect result?
Melissa: …
Melissa: I was lucky.
Melissa: Now it’s your turn, Anon. 
You: Alright, here I go…
You: Damn, it went to the side.
Melissa: It’s called the gutter. You have one more throw.
You: …
#bot.Expression.happy
You: I got a few, but 5 are still standing.
Bot: Good job! 
#bot.Expression.clear
Melissa: It’s your turn now, {f_botName}.
Bot: I will show you what I got!
Bot: …
Melissa: You left one pin.
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: Yes, I can see that!
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: I still have a second throw, right?
Melissa: Yes, you do.
Bot: …
You: Damn, it went into the gutter.{{wi}} No, wait! It bounced out and hit the last pin!
#bot.Expression.veryhappy
Bot: Yes! I did it!
Melissa: It doesn’t count.
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: What?! You are making this up so that you will win!
Melissa: Don’t trust me? Check the rules for yourself.
Bot: I will!
Bot: …
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: You are right…{{wi}} I’m sorry…
#bot.Expression.clear
Melissa: We are not playing for points today, let’s just throw a few times and learn the rules.
You: Sounds good to me.
